findings.title: Preserve the original light-theme color scaling
findings.body: This link previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the first `dark-light-choose` branch now uses 70%. Light themes select that first branch, so this change makes the link substantially lighter than before; the dark-theme branch also uses 30% of `$secondary` rather than the complementary 70%. Keep the 30% primary value and use 70% for the secondary value.

findings.title: Custom-message length color uses reversed lightness values
findings.body: This color previously scaled `$primary` by 70%, but the first `dark-light-choose` branch now scales it by 30%. Light themes therefore render a different, darker color than before, and the secondary branch uses 70% where the complementary value is 30%. Preserve the original 70% primary scaling and use 30% for the secondary branch.

findings.title: Group member name color no longer preserves the light-theme value
findings.body: The group-member name previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the first `dark-light-choose` branch now uses 50%. Light themes select this branch, so the name becomes noticeably lighter than before; the corresponding dark-theme value should use 70% of `$secondary`. Restore the 30% primary value and use 70% for the secondary value.

findings.title: Mobile group member name color no longer preserves the light-theme value
findings.body: The group-member name previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the first `dark-light-choose` branch now uses 50%. Light themes select this branch, so the name becomes noticeably lighter than before; the corresponding dark-theme value should use 70% of `$secondary`. Restore the 30% primary value and use 70% for the secondary value.

findings.title: Topic-map heading lightness changed unintentionally
findings.body: This heading previously used `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`, but the first `dark-light-choose` branch now uses 50%. Light themes select that branch, changing the existing heading color, and the complementary dark-theme branch should use 80% of `$secondary`. Preserve the 20% primary value and use 80% for the secondary value.
